retained_original_metadata.title: Left and right Noetherianity of genus-zero quantum graph algebras for complex semisimple Lie algebras, their Laurent integral forms and nonzero specializations
retained_original_metadata.source_version: Official SIGMA 20 (2024) article 047, DOI 10.3842/SIGMA.2024.047; journal PDF and native TeX acquired 2026-09-30, exact bytes pinned by SHA256
retained_original_metadata.difficulty_reason: The author constructs a refined weight filtration adapted to the braided product and derives ordered polynormal relations from the R-matrix. The mixed tensor factors require a second coadjoint-weight grading to eliminate unwanted leading terms; canonical-basis integrality then carries the construction over the Laurent ring. This is a substantive quantum-algebra structure proof rather than a direct use of Noetherianity for a commutative polynomial ring.
retained_original_metadata.author: Stéphane Baseilhac; Philippe Roche
